title: Inbound event
description: PERD REQ-API-008 and §39.6: an event from an enterprise source (Tushe, or later a real enterprise), authenticated, deduplicated by (source, event_id) and used only as a trigger for fresh reads; it never changes a fact or a verdict by itself (§21.5). Both effective time (occurred_at) and ingestion time (received_at, set by the inbox) are kept. The PERD gives no field list, so this is the smallest envelope those rules need [REC]; the payload is opaque data and never instructions (REQ-CTX-007).

delivery_id.description: Webhook relay delivery ID; the inbox deduplicates by it when present.

sequence.description: Cursor position when read by polling GET /v1/events.
